dayLines: 💛 You hold Knife roll. Breathe. The shaking eases. (−6 trauma)
📖 LEARNED: Old World Caches (Level 1). You know where people hid things: under floorboards, in hollow trees, behind loose bricks.
You've learned Old World Caches — it carries Eagle Eye.

Travel 1 tile to creek.
— Moving water —
The creek braids around gravel bars. Crawdads flick backward into the shadows of rocks.
The overlay's tone has changed around you. Warmer. It notices you noticing.
◈ THE CREEP — Ursula's thoughts have an echo now. The System's echo. Or theirs. Hard to tell anymore. Gifts used in sequence resonate — try them together. (Ability slots: 5)
✅ You saw the creek. Luis nods. "Good. Now we know." (+integration)
You catch fragments by the fire — Victor telling Douglas about Luis. The retelling is already better than the event.
This patch is worked out — step to another green patch and forage again.

Travel 2 tiles to trail edge.
— An old trail —
Scat on the trail, still soft. You study it longer than is dignified and learn exactly one thing: walk louder.
Journal: Trampled ground. The humble weeds win.
You work the patch with practiced hands: 8× Blackberry (520 kcal). This patch is picked clean — it'll recover in a few days.
You set a Snare here. Check it tomorrow.
Travel 1 tile to forest floor.
📋 Douglas — 🎣 Fish. They'll report back by next part.
"Why are YOU giving orders?" Anjali doesn't raise their voice. That's worse.
📋 Anjali — 🎣 Fish. They'll report back by next part.
📋 Skylar — 🍲 Cook. They'll report back by next part.

Wolfgang leans in, voice low. "Here's what we figured out about The Mountain Lord. Stand tall and shout. When it crouches to pounce, STAND TALL and SHOUT — bang metal, wave your arms, be loud and enormous. It expects prey to flee. Be the thing that doesn't, and the pounce dies unlaunched."

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Mountain Lord: Stand tall and shout. When it crouches to pounce, STAND TALL and SHOUT — bang metal, wave your arms, be loud and enormous. It expects prey to flee. Be the thing that doesn't, and the pounce dies unlaunched. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

📓 Codex: Counter: Stand tall and shout — When it crouches to pounce, STAND TALL and SHOUT — bang metal, wave your arms, be loud and enormous. It expects prey to flee. Be the thing that doesn't, and the pounce dies unlaunched.
✨ Ability gained: Cornered Rat (L1). When surrounded (3+ enemies), +100% damage and +50% dodge. Desperation is a weapon.
"BACK AGAINST THE WALL! Teeth BARE! We are cheering SO loud right now!"
"The REAL power? That comes from UNDERSTANDING. Use it! Learn it! The gamblers are watching!"
You chew the bitter leaves. Folk say it helps — you wouldn't know. (+2 health, maybe)
You eat Blackberry (520 kcal).
Travel 1 tile to Haven.
You walk back into Haven. 20 Codex entries. The village is glad to see you.
Walking 5 squares (10 kcal)…
You step into the Haven hall.
